newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Rwandan Hutus try to reach Congo, ICRC says.
newsitem.headline: Rwandan Hutus try to reach Congo, ICRC says.

text.p: About 20,000 Rwandan Hutus fleeing rebels in Zaire are trying to cross into neighbouring Congo, the International Committee of the Red Cross said on Thursday.
A statement from the Geneva-based ICRC said more than 3,000 Rwandan Hutu refugees had arrived in Congo's fishing village of Liranga and several hundred more were crossing by river every day.

The ICRC was giving temporary assistance to the Hutus, who were being charged by local boatmen for the passage and those too sick or without money were being left behind. Many were in an appalling state after long treks through Zaire's jungles.
The refugees are among the remnants of the Hutus who fled into Zaire from Rwanda in fear of reprisal for 1994's Hutu-led genocide of Tutsis. More than half a million Hutus went home late last year.
